text_blocks.snippet: Symptoms of bone cancer in the skull may vary depending on the type of cancer, location, and size of the tumor. Common symptoms include:

list.snippet: Headaches: Persistent or severe headaches, especially in the front or back of the head.
Facial pain or numbness: Pain or numbness in the face, nose, or cheeks.
Vision problems: Blurred vision, double vision, or loss of vision.
Hearing loss: Hearing loss or ringing in the ears.
Nasal congestion or discharge: Nasal stuffiness, runny nose, or loss of sense of smell.
